acceptance_rule: Within every requested independent trial, positive increment requires paired point>0 and CI95 lower>0. The 2% target is validated only when paired point>=2 and CI95 lower>=2 in every trial; point>=2 alone is reported separately. Require exact full-model gradient/update fingerprints, identical trajectories, owned column input reuse and actual collective removal. All balanced blocks retained; one trial is exploratory.
limitation: Fixed synthetic inputs and this configuration only; no long-term convergence claim.
